title: Same-level coefficient stage arrows are finite free
statement: For stages s and t over the same fixed finite extension E of Q_l, let a:s→t record a field embedding compatible with E. If their positive exponents agree, the actual quotient ring t.ring is finite free over s.ring through a.ringMap; in particular no unramified hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Finite coefficient stages and cofinal ramified indices; the arithmetic part of lem-pur-finite-coefficient-adjoint-comparisons.

proof.text: Use the embedding as the field algebra structure. The upper valuation ring is the integral closure of the lower DVR in the finite field extension. It is finite and torsion free, hence free. Base-changing that finite basis along the quotient by the source principal-power ideal gives a finite free quotient module. The arrow compatibility maps the source parameter to the target parameter, so at equal exponents the base-changed quotient is exactly t.ring with the recorded ring map.

proof_origin.place: Direct DVR expansion and integral-closure/quotient-base-change arguments.
